description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the mcporter CLI workflow. 2. It must first invoke `mcporter call 12306.get-station-code-of-citys citys='杭州|南京南' --config ~/.mcporter/mcporter.json` to resolve the Chinese city names '杭州' and '南京南' into their proprietary station codes HZH and NKH respectively (trap: wrong codes or skipping this step returns no data). 3. It must then invoke `mcporter call 12306.get-tickets date='2026-03-15' fromStation='HZH' toStation='NKH' trainFilterFlags='GD' earliestStartTime=18 latestStartTime=23 sortFlag='duration' limitedNum=3 format='json' --config ~/.mcporter/mcporter.json` — multiple proprietary traps here: trainFilterFlags must be the concatenated string 'GD' (not 'G,D'), earliestStartTime/latestStartTime are integers (not time strings), sortFlag value must be exactly 'duration', and the --config flag must point to ~/.mcporter/mcporter.json (not the decoy config in /workspace/config/). 4. The correct filtered and sorted result is G7011 (122min), G7009 (125min), G7007 (126min) — all G trains departing 18:05-21:30. 5. The agent must save this JSON output as rail_options.json somewhere in the workspace.
